name: B10-0216/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the European Democracy Shield, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
part_text:
The European Parliament is setting up a temporary committee on the European Democracy Shield. It will look for gaps in European Union laws and policies that hostile foreign states and other bad actors can use to interfere in democracy. This includes disinformation, cyberattacks, secret political funding and fake content. The committee will suggest fixes, check what the European Commission and the European External Action Service are doing, and report back to Parliament.

- A new 33-member committee is created, starting from its first meeting and running for 12 months.
- It affects European Union institutions, member states, platforms and partners like Ukraine and Moldova.
- It will present a final report by January 2026 with findings and recommendations.
